instruction: Can you enable the cone icon in the splash screen? I actually like the classic VLC look.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC cone icon in splash screen (opposite of original task). Uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric to validate the qt-bgcone setting (1=enabled, 0=disabled) in vlcrc config file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to enable VLC cone icon in splash screen
Getter (get_vlc_config) properly extracts vlcrc config file from VM to read qt-bgcone setting
Metric (check_qt_bgcone) correctly parses vlcrc file and compares qt-bgcone value against expected value of 1 (enabled)
Expected value (expected_qt_bgcone: 1) semantically matches the instruction requirement to enable the cone icon
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are persisted and visible
Logic handles default value correctly (qt-bgcone defaults to 1 if not explicitly set in config)
Complete coverage: single-step task with appropriate single verification point
No edge case issues: metric handles type conversion and missing config lines correctly
